## Rankings

### create 1k rows

| ---: | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 1 | **mreact** | create 1k rows | 8.9671 | best | ms |
| 2 | react | create 1k rows | 9.9406 | +10.86% | ms |
| 3 | solid-v2 | create 1k rows | 10.1228 | +12.89% | ms |
| 4 | solid | create 1k rows | 11.4197 | +27.35% | ms |

| 6 | qwik | create 1k rows | 12.9724 | +44.67% | ms |
| 7 | marko | create 1k rows | 14.6713 | +63.61% | ms |
